rationale: Revised plan corrects two critical statistical issues from the prior attempt. The denial_rate component now uses 'adjudicated_claims' denominator to exclude pending claims that have not yet been resolved (Paid, Denied, Adjusted states only), yielding the correct denial rate of 1286 / 12339 = 0.1042. The monthly_trend component now keys on 'service_date_from' rather than 'adjudication_date' to capture utilization patterns based on when care was delivered rather than when claims were processed; this ensures accurate monthly volume trends. All other components remain unchanged to preserve the comprehensive portfolio view.
changes_summary: Two parameter corrections: (1) denial_rate.denominator changed from 'all_claims' to 'adjudicated_claims' to exclude pending claims and correctly calculate the denial rate; (2) monthly_trend.date_column changed from 'adjudication_date' to 'service_date_from' to represent utilization timing accurately.
